mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakness in the housing and retail sectors, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), the manufacturing sector slowdown reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery regimes (GDPC1 > 16000), the rebound in consumer demand (RSAFS) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 16000 and RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate investment and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
